Questions, answered.

Do I have to approve every post?

No. You approve your headshot, logo and details once when you sign up. After that, your posts go out on their own every week. Want to stop? Cancel anytime through PayPal or email us.

Is there a free trial?

Start with the free AI report. It shows how AI sees you today, at no cost. Signature itself is month to month with no contract, so you can cancel anytime.

Will another agent get the same posts?

No. Your posts are built for your ZIP codes and your brand, and carry your name.

Where do the market numbers come from?

From trusted local market data for your area, checked before every post. The data date is printed on every post that uses numbers.

Do I have to film anything?

No. Reels are coming soon, and they will not need filming either.

Can you guarantee I’ll show up in ChatGPT or Google?

No one can honestly promise that. We publish fresh, specific, local information under your name every week, which is what search engines and AI assistants look for.

Hi Alex, here’s your market this month and three things worth doing before the next one.

Your market in 60 seconds

797Homes for sale, up 26.5% from a year ago
3.5Months of supply
~50Days to sell
97.3%Of asking price

More homes and more time means buyers are comparing. Sellers who price right on day one sell first.

What buyers asked AI this month

Is Gilbert a buyer’s market right now?
Best neighborhoods in Gilbert for families?
Who are the top real estate agents in Gilbert?

Agents who answer these questions in plain words, with dates and numbers, are the ones AI tends to quote.

Where you show up

We asked ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity 30 buyer and seller questions about Gilbert. Alex Roberts was named in 3 answers. Your full AI report shows who was named instead.

3 tips for this month

Post one number a weekA single local stat with its date builds more trust than a stock photo.
Refresh your Google profile photosAdd a new headshot or a local listing photo. Fresh profiles look active.
Answer one buyer questionPick a question above and answer it in three sentences on your page.
